description: Returns a short-lived link to one version of the site as a zip — the version the Development address serves, the one the Live address serves (env live), or the one named — for the founder's browser. Owner only; each download is on the founder's Logs. Changes nothing. This is what a founder may call a copy or backup of the website.

env.description: with no version: which address's version; default development

version.description: leave out for the version the address serves

name: site_download
title: Download a site version
